verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for marketing automation platforms, since self-hostable alternatives exist, so the axis applies. The evidence describes only HubSpot-hosted SaaS features and APIs. The local development CLI is for building CMS templates and modules, not for running the core product on your own infrastructure, so there is no evidence the product can be self-hosted.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
